name: Reading Progress Bar
summary: Decorative article-position indicator with exclusive controlled and explicitly associated automatic measurement paths, host-owned placement, bounded visual output, and no task-completion semantics.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive decorative track that is hidden from assistive technology and remains in the host's layout context.

anatomy.name: bar
anatomy.description: Decorative fill projected from logical inline start through a private transform scale.

variants.name: controlled
variants.description: Target supplies one finite bounded article-position value and owns every measurement lifecycle.

variants.name: automatic
variants.description: Capable adapter measures one explicitly associated article against the viewport or an explicitly associated scroll root.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One thin intrinsic track; placement and surrounding offsets belong to the host.

states.name: automatic
states.description: Visible bounded position derived from the explicitly associated article range.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: Automatic article range is not scrollable or is no longer connected, so the decorative indicator is omitted.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Required controlled value or automatic associations are invalid, so the component fails closed.

behavior.name: decorativeSemantics
behavior.description: Article position is supplemental visual information, not task completion, an operable scrollbar, a meter, or a live status.

behavior.name: exclusiveSource
behavior.description: Controlled consumes only value; Automatic requires one explicit article id and optionally one explicit scroll-root id. The two source paths are never mixed.

behavior.name: automaticMeasurement
behavior.description: Capable Web adapters normalize article start-to-end position, coalesce visual writes to requestAnimationFrame, recompute after relevant geometry changes, attach listeners only while an automatic root exists, and perform no polling.

behavior.name: hostPlacement
behavior.description: The owning page or layout chooses fixed, sticky, safe-area, Header-offset, stacking or in-flow placement; L4 exposes no viewport-placement property.

behavior.name: passiveOutput
behavior.description: Bounded output updates only visual state, emits no event and never claims content was read, understood or completed.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Exclusive source path: target-supplied Controlled value or explicitly associated Automatic article measurement.

properties.name: value
properties.unsetBehavior: Required in Controlled mode and ignored in Automatic mode; invalid controlled input omits the component.
properties.description: Finite bounded article-position percentage supplied by the target in Controlled mode; it does not represent task completion.

properties.name: targetId
properties.unsetBehavior: Required in Automatic mode and omitted in Controlled mode.
properties.description: Stable identifier of the explicitly associated article range used by capable Web adapters; other targets map the same source relationship natively.

properties.name: scrollRootId
properties.unsetBehavior: Automatic mode uses the document viewport when no explicit scroll root is supplied; Controlled mode omits it.
properties.description: Optional explicit scroll-container identifier for an automatic embedded reading surface; the referenced container must contain the article target.

accessibility: Keep the root aria-hidden, non-focusable, non-live and pointer-transparent; do not add progressbar, scrollbar, meter or status semantics.
Preserve native article headings, landmarks, browser scrolling and optional Table of Contents as the accessible navigation model.
Do not claim that article position means content was read, understood or completed.
Project visual progress from logical inline start, including RTL, and retain a forced-color fill without making the cue the only source of information.
Omit automatic indicators for invalid, disconnected, short or non-scrollable ranges rather than exposing stale or false position.

web.notes: Decorative controlled projection and explicit automatic article/scroll-root measurement with coalesced shared runtime and complete cleanup.

shopify.notes: Requires a selected article/template owner, explicit source association and Theme Editor lifecycle before Automatic is target-ready; Controlled remains available to a target service.
